description: MBRC Planning Scheme - Flood Hazard Overlay Drainage Investigation Areas is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Moreton Bay's Data Hub. Version 1 February 2016 Moreton Bay Regional Council has finalised a new planning scheme that supports growth and maintains the region’s unique characteristics. The MBRC Planning Scheme is to commence 1 February 2016. Please use this data in conjunction with the Flood Hazard and North Lakes Locality. Coverage: City of Moreton Bay's Data Hub. The portal files it under the publisher City of Moreton Bay's Data Hub. Its tags are autogen, mbrc, planning-scheme, town-planning. It offers 6 resource(s) in arcgis geoservices rest api, csv, geojson, html, kml. The portal shows 2026-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
